watched #Kaamyaab : @Netflix – if you are in game for non-commericial movie with simple story line and excellent performances this is a must watch!!!!

with around 1.5 hrs of duration this movie shows the true feelings of side kicks of our Bollywood who even after being in tons of movies go unnoticed and the age of social media memes gives them a hope when ppl recognize them due to their memes!!!

as usual Sanjay Mishra has done a terrific performance and carried the whole movie on his shoulders!!!! Director has not tried anything to put melodramatic and the story looks realistic in every sense including a very well written climax with bottom line – No matter how well a side kick performs or no matter how well the audience enjoys the side kicks acting he will be always over shadowed by the “HERO” _/\_
